input.prompt:
Create ONE complete finished 3200x1440 game screen in the EXACT approved visual system of Image1. Image1 is our approved 风暴怕死队-style battle master. The user approved this direction: preserve its hanging-page tabs, enlarged hand-drawn resource icons, letterforms, palette, timber/brass frames, slot surfaces, item art, contour weight and spacing. Supporting official screenshots establish the same UI family; do not copy their game text or mechanics.

Keep the shared header pixel positions and scale. Exactly three tabs 装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴; change only the selected tab as this page requires. Top right remains 生命180/180 full, 体力100/100 full, 腐化0/100 EMPTY, 金币4. Preserve the master's LARGE icons and numbers; never shrink them. All body text must be clear at phone scale: preferably at least56px, important numbers64px. Keep Chinese typography consistent with Image1.

Unless the page explicitly replaces the left+central area with a wide sheet, preserve BOTH side panels from Image1: 战斗装备 and 背包, matching top, bottom, width, title baseline and all four card rows. Both use ONE COLUMN of full-width horizontal cards, never split cells. Default left cards: green vial8/1, pale mushroom4 only, silver dagger30/2 with one purple enchantment mark and EMPTY0/100; fourth locked. Default right: three empty full-width cards and bottom locked. Page-specific ownership changes below override only those stated rows. Names/descriptions do not appear permanently on the equipped side cards.

Only the central page content, contextual title and authorized states/actions change. Use the approved hand-inked, warm brown/ochre UI with simple colored item art; no new art style, generic dark CSS boxes, photoreal metallic bevels, copied source-game branding, keyboard hints or developer placeholders. Selected controls and buttons should share the official game's warm amber/green-corner visual language and readable cream lettering. One primary task/action; align all bottom actions, with quieter secondary action at the left and primary at right. Remove battle aiming instructions on non-battle pages. Do not invent game features, fees, resources or extra controls beyond the page spec. Render the ENTIRE final screenshot with all art, labels and numbers in the image model.


PAGE 08 — 营地 · 地牢选择 / DUNGEON SELECTION

Generate one COMPLETE dungeon-selection screen opened from the preparation camp, using the shared style and the approved 风暴怕死队 UI master. Preserve the new hanging paper PAGE TABS, enlarged top-right status icons, exact resource values and established component construction. “装备栏位” remains the selected global tab. The central title is “选择地牢”.

FIXED SHARED COLUMNS:
LEFT “战斗装备” keeps the normal three-item build in the original order and row positions: 凝血毒剂 in row 1 with damage 8 / recycle 1; 灵魂香菇 in row 2 with recycle 4 and no damage; 淬毒利刃 in row 3 with damage 30 / recycle 2 / one purple enchantment marker / EMPTY charge 0/100; the bottom card remains locked.
RIGHT “背包” remains THREE EMPTY FULL-WIDTH horizontal cards stacked in ONE column and ONE bottom locked card. Both sides retain the same outer dimensions, title baseline, card widths, card heights and matching row edges as the master. No two-column empty grid and no duplicated equipment in the backpack.

CENTRAL SELECTION TASK:
Show EXACTLY THREE large, legible floor choices in one coherent sequence, with consistent card geometry and a clear selected state:
“第1层” — “已通关 · 可重打”. Its treatment remains available and readable, not disabled; completion does not prevent another run.
“第2层” — “已选择”. This is the sole current selection, distinguished by the approved warm selected outline/surface and the explicit state text.
“第3层” — “未解锁”. Use the same component family with a clear lock and subdued treatment; do not imply it can currently be entered.

Each floor may have a concise original dungeon doorway or depth illustration from our game's established world, subordinate to its number and state. Keep the illustration inside its choice card. Do not reproduce another game's distinctive scenic composition. These three floor states are a visual concept example, not a claim about an actual player save; do not add explanation text about that distinction inside the game screen.

One prominent main action at the established bottom action area: “进入第2层”.
One secondary control: “返回营地”.
Only the second floor is selected. Do not add a separate enter button to every choice. Do not invent branching routes, node maps, star ratings, timers, entry fees, reward amounts, recommended power, boss labels, extra floors or an arbitrary total floor count. No price, skill-point cost or currency deduction is shown. The entire screen remains a cleanly readable generated game UI with the mother screen's hanging tabs, status icon scale and aligned full-width side cards.
